For ſince the time that Phœbus fooliſh ſonne
Ythundered through Ioues auengefull wrath,
For trauerſing the charret of the Sunne
Beyond the compaſſe of his pointed path […]
1591, Ed[mund] Sp[enser], “The Teares of the Muses”, in Complaints. Containing Sundrie Small Poemes of the Worlds Vanitie. […], London: […] William Ponsonbie, […], →OCLC:

e: From Middle English ythe, ithe, uthe, from Old English ȳþ, from Proto-Germanic *unþī (“wave”).
